newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares set for major upsurge after Dow gain.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares set for major upsurge after Dow gain.

text.p: Danish share prices were expected to surge ahead on Wednesday echoing Wall Street's solid rise and following a limited local rally on Tuesday on better than expected U.S. key data.

"Although we rallied in late trade on yesterday's encouraging U.S. employment cost and durable goods figures it was not enough to lift the index into the black, so we expect to make good today with major advances," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.17 point down on Tuesday at 156.09. The market was due to reopen at 0700 gmt Wednesday.
